SELECT
  customers.id AS "customers.id",
  customers.name AS "customers.name",
  customers.region_id AS "customers.region_id",
  regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
  customers.credit AS "customers.credit"
FROM customers AS customers
LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
  ON customers.region_id = regions.id
LIMIT 21

args.message: I grouped all 202 customers by region and counted orders by each customer's region. The fifth row (blank region) is for unknown region: one customer with no region and a 500 credit limit. That row also gets 16 orders, made up of that customer's orders plus orders with no matching customer. The order counts add up to all 5,016 orders. Arctic doesn't appear because it has no customers.
